PlayCanvas engine + official camera-controls script, VENDORED (F-28, 2026-09-02).

Why: the importmap used to point at jsDelivr, so every delivered tour fetched the engine
at runtime — one CDN outage/geo-block takes every customer link dark at once, with no SRI
and no CSP. The bundle is now self-contained; scripts/package_viewer_pc.sh gates on it
(exit 9: no absolute external URL may reappear in the bundled html/js).

Fetched 2026-09-02 with curl + a browser User-Agent (bare urllib is killed by some CDNs —
.claude/rules/known-issues.md):

  playcanvas.mjs        https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/playcanvas@2.21.4/+esm
                        sha256 add850391c2e5370894713cef34f9907921f476d5dbc825ac49b4b363c15bfdf
                        2349429 bytes — byte-exact copy of what the importmap served before.
                        NB this is a jsDelivr-GENERATED rollup+esbuild bundle of
                        playcanvas@2.21.4/build/playcanvas/src/index.js, not a published
                        package file, so it is not SRI-pinnable upstream; the sha above is
                        our pin. Its trailing //# sourceMappingURL=/sm/... is a jsDelivr
                        path that 404s locally — harmless, devtools-only.

Upgrading: re-fetch all three at the new version, update index.html's importmap comment,
re-run scripts/package_viewer_pc.sh (the URL gate) and the walk gates.
